color_palette.name: Sproutly Cloud
color_palette.usage: Primary page background and card surfaces across all pages — the clean white canvas that makes the bright clothing photography and color blocks pop; used in nav bar, product cards, FAQ panels, and form fields

color_palette.name: Adventure Sky
color_palette.usage: Primary brand blue — the dominant hero color used in large soft-block backgrounds on the Home hero and Join Sproutly Club hero, primary CTA buttons, active navigation states, and loyalty club badge fills

color_palette.name: Sprout Mint
color_palette.usage: Secondary energetic accent — fills feature grid card backgrounds, collection category tags on the Collections page, illustrated icon backgrounds, and hover states on gallery thumbnails; brings the fresh, growing-things energy of the brand name

color_palette.name: Playdate Coral
color_palette.usage: Warm action accent — used for secondary CTA buttons, sale or new-arrival badges on product cards, stat callout numbers on the Home stats section, and the timeline node markers on the Our Story page; energetic without being alarming

color_palette.name: Sunshine Squeal
color_palette.usage: Joyful highlight color — applied to testimonial quote marks, loyalty club benefit icons, story-block pull-quote backgrounds, and decorative dot/blob motifs that float behind gallery sections; keeps the palette feeling like a child's crayon box

color_palette.name: Puddle Purple
color_palette.usage: Playful contrast accent — used for eyebrow label pills (e.g., 'New Collection', 'Ages 2–5'), FAQ accordion active-state borders, and the Sproutly Club membership tier badge; adds a surprise hue that feels imaginative and kid-coded

color_palette.name: Muddy Trail
color_palette.usage: Primary text color for all body copy, headings, nav links, and footer text — a warm near-black that feels human and approachable rather than cold or corporate; used at full opacity for H1–H3 and reduced opacity (70%) for meta labels

color_palette.name: Soft Pebble
color_palette.usage: Subtle off-white used for alternating section backgrounds, testimonial card fills, and FAQ row stripes — provides gentle visual rhythm without introducing a second neutral that fights the bright accent blocks

typography.heading_treatment: Nunito at display weights (800–900) with slightly tight letter-spacing (−0.01em) and generous line-height (1.15) for H1 hero statements; H2 section titles at Bold (700), sentence case, to keep the tone warm and conversational rather than shouty; H3 card titles at SemiBold (600) — the rounded letterforms mirror the rounded-card UI language and feel built for a brand whose customers are kids and the parents who love them
typography.body_treatment: DM Sans at Regular (400) for body paragraphs at 16–18px with a 1.65 line-height and comfortable measure (60–72ch) — clean, open, and highly readable for parents scanning product descriptions, FAQ answers, and brand story copy on mobile and desktop alike; Medium (500) for UI labels, nav items, and button text
typography.accent_treatment: Fredoka One used exclusively for small accent moments at ≤14px — eyebrow labels above section titles (e.g., 'NEW IN', 'AGES 6–12'), badge text on product cards, loyalty club tier names, and stat unit labels — its bubbly single-weight display character adds a kid-friendly sticker energy that would overpower body or heading roles

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
## Sproutly Home Page — Visual Design Plan

### Page Role & Ambition
This is the arrival moment for the entire Sproutly world. The page must hit parents with an immediate jolt of color, joy, and kinetic energy — communicating in under a second that this is a brand built for kids who live loudly. The gallery-first layout family demands that imagery and color blocks dominate structure; copy is subordinate to visual impact. The friendly_consumer_app aesthetic means every surface is rounded, every interaction feels warm, and the color palette is used at full saturation — not politely dabbed onto buttons and eyebrows.

### Section Sequence & Rhythm
The six sections follow a deliberate density arc: LOUD → focused → dominant → punchy → warm → closing.

1. **Hero** — Maximum energy. Full-bleed Adventure Sky (#3AABF0) color flood with a dominant illustration and oversized display type. The page's signature moment lives here.
2. **Feature Grid** — A focused, card-forward pause. Soft Pebble (#F2F0ED) background, four rounded mint-backed cards in a 2×2 grid. Compact but rich.
3. **Gallery** — The page's visual centerpiece. A masonry-style, asymmetric image grid that dominates the viewport. Full-bleed edge-to-edge. Minimal copy. The clothes lead.
4. **Stats** — A punchy, high-contrast full-bleed Playdate Coral (#FF6B5B) band. Oversized numerals in white. Horizontal marquee rhythm. Breaks the page's color cadence dramatically.
5. **Testimonials** — A soft, ambient warmth. Soft Pebble background, staggered card layout, Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D) oversized quote marks as decorative anchors.
6. **CTA Close** — A confident, warm flourish. Adventure Sky (#3AABF0) background with the repeating pattern asset tiling behind the copy. Single centered action.

The page alternates between high-density visual sections (1, 3) and more focused, readable sections (2, 5), with two full-bleed color bands (4, 6) creating strong punctuation. No two consecutive sections share a background color or structural skeleton.

### Signature Moment
**The Hero Headline Bleed** — The H1 "Dressed for Every Adventure." is set in Nunito at display weight (900), enormous (fluid type scaling from ~72px mobile to ~120px desktop), in pure white, and it intentionally overflows its left text column to bleed partially behind the hero illustration on the right. The period at the end is rendered in Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D) as a typographic sticker — a single glowing dot that punctuates the brand's playful confidence. The illustration of the running child is positioned to overlap the headline's right edge, creating a layered, non-rectangular composition where type and image occupy the same z-plane. This is the aesthetic's "overlapping cutout" visual cue at full amplitude — not tucked in a corner, but structurally defining the entire hero. It belongs to this aesthetic because the friendly_consumer_app vocabulary is about warmth and approachability through unexpected playfulness, and a headline that breaks its own container feels like a kid who can't be contained.

### Signature Motion Moment
**The Headline Bleed Entrance** — On page load, the hero illustration slides in from the right edge of the viewport (a generous, easy-feeling drift, not a snap), while simultaneously the headline text builds from left to right, word by word, each word fading and scaling up from 80% to 100% in a quick stagger — "Dressed" lands first, then "for", then "Every", then "Adventure." The Sunshine Squeal period pulses once with a gentle scale-up (like a heartbeat) exactly as the final word settles. The illustration and headline arrive at roughly the same moment, creating the illusion that they're chasing each other into frame. This motion sequence lasts approximately 1.2 seconds total and sets the kinetic register for the entire page.

### Motion Design — Full Page Arc
**On-load arc:**
- The Adventure Sky hero background floods in first as a full-bleed color wash (a very fast fade, almost instant, establishing the canvas).
- A half-beat later, the eyebrow pill ("New Season Is Here") slides down from above the headline position.
- Then the headline words stagger in left-to-right (the signature motion moment described above).
- The subheadline fades up a beat after the headline settles.
- The two CTA buttons scale up from 90% to 100% together, a beat after the subheadline.
- The illustration drifts in from the right simultaneously with the headline stagger.
- A very slow, continuous ambient drift animates the illustration — a gentle 3–4px vertical float on a 4-second loop, giving the running child a sense of perpetual motion.

**Scroll-triggered reveals:**
- Feature Grid (Section 2): The section headline fades up, then the four cards stagger in from below in a 2×2 wave (top-left → top-right → bottom-left → bottom-right), each card slightly delayed from the previous.
- Gallery (Section 3): Gallery tiles scale from 95% to 100% and fade in, staggered by position — the large anchor tiles arrive first, smaller tiles follow in a cascade.
- Stats (Section 4): The four stat numbers count up from zero to their final value as the section enters the viewport — a classic, satisfying reveal. The marquee strip (if used) runs continuously regardless.
- Testimonials (Section 5): Cards slide up and fade in, staggered left to right. The Sunshine Squeal quote marks scale in with a slight overshoot (bouncy ease) just before the card text appears.
- CTA (Section 6): The headline fades and scales up from 95%, then the button pulses once gently to draw the eye.

**Hover & focus affordances:**
- Feature grid cards: lift 6px upward, shadow deepens from a soft ambient shadow to a more pronounced drop shadow, mint background brightens slightly.
- Gallery tiles: a Sprout Mint (#4DDBB4) color overlay fades in at ~20% opacity over the image, and the product name label slides up from below the tile's bottom edge.
- CTA buttons (primary, Adventure Sky): background shifts one shade deeper, a subtle scale-up to 103%, shadow appears beneath.
- CTA buttons (secondary, outlined): border thickens, text color shifts to Playdate Coral (#FF6B5B).
- Nav links: a short Sunshine Squeal underline grows from left to right on hover.
- Testimonial cards: a very gentle 2px lift, border color shifts to Sprout Mint.

**Ambient looped motion:**
- Hero illustration: slow 4-second vertical float (3–4px up and down), looping infinitely, giving the child a sense of mid-run suspension.
- Decorative dot/blob motifs floating behind the gallery section drift very slowly (parallax-style, moving at ~20% of scroll speed relative to the gallery tiles).
- The CTA section's pattern background tiles scroll at a slow, barely-perceptible horizontal drift — like a gentle breeze across the pattern.
- The stat numbers in Section 4 count up on scroll entry (not a loop, but a one-time triggered animation that feels kinetic and alive).

### Color & Surface Usage Across Sections
- Section 1: Adventure Sky (#3AABF0) full-bleed background. White headline. Sunshine Squeal period. Puddle Purple (#B57BFF) eyebrow pill.
- Section 2: Soft Pebble (#F2F0ED) background. Sprout Mint (#4DDBB4) card backgrounds. Muddy Trail (#3D3535) headings and body. Puddle Purple eyebrow pill.
- Section 3: White (#FFFFFF) background. Full-bleed imagery dominates. Sprout Mint hover overlay. Playdate Coral (#FF6B5B) age-range badges. Puddle Purple category tags.
- Section 4: Playdate Coral (#FF6B5B) full-bleed background. White numerals and labels. Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D) unit labels (Fredoka One).
- Section 5: Soft Pebble (#F2F0ED) background. White card surfaces. Sunshine Squeal oversized quote marks. Muddy Trail body text.
- Section 6: Adventure Sky (#3AABF0) background with pattern overlay. White headline and subheadline. White CTA button with Adventure Sky text.

### Typography Hierarchy
- H1 (Hero): Nunito 900, ~120px desktop / ~64px mobile, white, tight letter-spacing (−0.01em), line-height 1.1.
- H2 (Section titles): Nunito 700, ~40px desktop / ~28px mobile, Muddy Trail (#3D3535) on light sections, white on dark/color sections.
- H3 (Card titles): Nunito 600, ~20px, Muddy Trail.
- Body: DM Sans 400, 16–18px, Muddy Trail at 70% opacity for meta, full opacity for descriptions.
- Eyebrow pills: Fredoka One, 12–13px, uppercase tracking, colored pill background (Puddle Purple with white text, or Sunshine Squeal with Muddy Trail text).
- Stat numerals: Nunito 900, ~72–80px desktop, white on Coral background.
- Stat unit labels: Fredoka One, 14px, Sunshine Squeal on Coral background.

### Density & Whitespace Logic
- Sections 1 and 3 are intentionally dense with visual material — minimal padding, imagery pushed to edges.
- Sections 2 and 5 breathe more: 80–96px vertical padding, cards have internal padding of ~28–32px.
- Sections 4 and 6 are compact color bands: ~64–72px vertical padding, copy is tight and purposeful.
- The page never gives two consecutive sections the same breathing room — dense always follows open, and vice versa.

### Responsive Behavior
- Hero: On mobile, the illustration moves above the headline (stacked layout), headline scales down to ~64px, both CTAs stack vertically.
- Feature Grid: 2×2 on desktop, single column on mobile (cards full width, stacked).
- Gallery: 3-column asymmetric masonry on desktop, 2-column on tablet, single column on mobile.
- Stats: 4-column horizontal on desktop, 2×2 grid on tablet, single column on mobile.
- Testimonials: 3-column on desktop, 1-column carousel on mobile.
- CTA: Centered single column on all breakpoints.

### Design System Fit
All typography uses Nunito (headings), DM Sans (body), and Fredoka One (accents) as specified. All colors draw exclusively from the defined palette. Rounded corners (16–24px on cards, 999px on pills and buttons) are consistent throughout. No sharp edges appear anywhere on the page. The page is unmistakably Sproutly and unmistakably gallery-first, with the hero and gallery sections dominating the visual weight of the scroll journey.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
SECTION 1 — HERO

Full-bleed Adventure Sky (#3AABF0) background that floods edge-to-edge, top to bottom, with zero margin or border radius — the color owns the entire viewport height (100vh on desktop, 90vh on mobile). No white gaps at the top; the navigation bar floats over this section in a transparent state with white text and logo.

LAYOUT: Asymmetric two-zone composition on desktop. The left ~55% of the container holds the text stack; the right ~45% holds the hero illustration. The illustration is NOT contained within a column — it overlaps the text zone's right edge, crossing the invisible column boundary so the running child's outstretched arm overlaps the headline's trailing words. This layered, non-rectangular composition is the page's SIGNATURE MOMENT.

TEXT STACK (left zone, vertically centered in the hero):
- Eyebrow pill: Fredoka One, 12px, uppercase, Puddle Purple (#B57BFF) background, white text, 999px border-radius, 8px vertical / 16px horizontal padding. Text: 'New Season Is Here'. Slides down from above on load.
- H1 Headline: Nunito 900 weight, ~120px desktop / ~64px mobile, white, letter-spacing −0.01em, line-height 1.05. Text: 'Dressed for Every Adventure.' The period at the end is rendered in Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D) — visually it reads as a glowing typographic sticker. The headline is left-aligned and intentionally overflows its column boundary, with the last word ('Adventure.') extending further right than the eyebrow and subheadline — creating a wedge shape that points toward the illustration. This is the signature visual move.
- Subheadline: DM Sans 400, 20px desktop / 16px mobile, white at 90% opacity, line-height 1.5, max-width ~480px. Text: 'Playful clothes built tough for kids who never stop moving.' Left-aligned beneath the headline with ~20px gap.
- CTA row: Two buttons, left-aligned, ~28px gap between them. Primary: 'Shop Collections' — rounded pill (999px), Adventure Sky darkened by ~15% for the background (#2A97D8 or similar deep sky), white text, DM Sans 500, 16px. On hover: scales to 103%, shadow deepens. Secondary: 'Meet Our Story' — white outlined pill, white text, transparent background. On hover: background fills white at 15% opacity, border stays white.

ILLUSTRATION (right zone, overlapping):
- The cheerful cartoon child running with arms wide open, stars and leaves trailing behind, is placed so the child's figure occupies the right 45% of the viewport but the trailing leaves and stars bleed leftward past the column midpoint, overlapping the lower portion of the headline text. The illustration sits at a slightly higher z-index than the text background but the headline text remains above it — creating the layered feel without obscuring readability.
- The illustration is positioned bottom-anchored: the child's feet sit near the bottom of the hero section, with the top of the figure reaching ~70% of the hero height. This gives the impression of a child running across the bottom of the frame.
- AMBIENT MOTION: The illustration floats vertically in a slow, looping 4-second cycle — drifting 4px upward then returning — giving the child a sense of perpetual mid-run suspension. The trailing stars and leaves also rotate very slowly (one full rotation per 8 seconds each, at different speeds) to feel like they're tumbling through air.

DECORATIVE DETAILS:
- Three or four small Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D) dot blobs (irregular rounded shapes, ~24–40px) float in the upper-right and lower-left of the hero, behind both the text and illustration layers. They drift very slowly on a parallax offset as the user scrolls.
- A subtle white wave or soft scalloped edge at the very bottom of the hero transitions into the next section — not a hard line, but a gentle curved boundary.

ON-LOAD MOTION ARC:
1. Adventure Sky background floods in (near-instant, ~100ms fade).
2. Eyebrow pill slides down from 12px above its resting position and fades in (~300ms).
3. Headline words stagger in left-to-right: 'Dressed' → 'for' → 'Every' → 'Adventure' — each word fades and scales from 80% to 100%, each word starting ~80ms after the previous. Total stagger ~400ms.
4. The Sunshine Squeal period pulses once (scales from 100% to 115% and back) exactly as 'Adventure' finishes landing.
5. Illustration drifts in from the right edge (slides ~60px leftward into position) simultaneously with the headline stagger, arriving at its final position as the headline completes.
6. Subheadline fades up a beat after the headline settles (~200ms delay after headline complete).
7. CTA buttons scale from 90% to 100% together, a beat after the subheadline (~150ms delay).

RESPONSIVE: On mobile, the illustration moves above the text stack (full-width, centered, ~280px tall), and the headline scales to ~56px. Both CTAs stack vertically, full-width. The period sticker effect is preserved at all breakpoints.

SPACING: 80px top padding (below nav), 80px bottom padding on desktop. Container is full-width; inner content uses a max-width of 1280px centered with 32px horizontal gutters on desktop, 20px on mobile.

SECTION 2 — FEATURE GRID

Background: Soft Pebble (#F2F0ED) — a gentle, breathable off-white that creates a deliberate contrast pause after the saturated hero. The section transitions from the hero's wave edge smoothly.

VERTICAL PADDING: 96px top and bottom on desktop, 64px on mobile. This section is meant to breathe — it's the focused, trust-building moment after the hero's energy.

HEADER BLOCK (centered, above the grid):
- Eyebrow pill: Fredoka One, 12px, uppercase, Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D) background, Muddy Trail (#3D3535) text, 999px border-radius. Text: 'Why Sproutly'. Centered.
- H2: Nunito 700, ~40px desktop / ~28px mobile, Muddy Trail (#3D3535), centered, line-height 1.2, letter-spacing −0.01em. Text: 'Made for Kids. Trusted by Parents.' Max-width 560px, centered.
- 32px gap between header block and card grid.

CARD GRID: 2×2 on desktop (two columns, two rows), single column on mobile. Grid gap: 24px. Max-width 880px, centered within the section container.

EACH CARD:
- Background: Sprout Mint (#4DDBB4). Border-radius: 24px. Padding: 32px on all sides.
- Icon: Illustrated icon (from the icon set asset — paint palette, shield with star, leaf, stretchy fabric swatch) displayed at ~64px × 64px, placed in the top-left of the card interior. The icon sits on a white circular background (~80px diameter) to make it pop against the Mint surface.
- Card H3: Nunito 600, 20px, Muddy Trail (#3D3535), 16px below the icon.
- Card body: DM Sans 400, 16px, Muddy Trail at 80% opacity, line-height 1.6, 8px below the H3.
- No CTA on individual cards — the cards are informational, not interactive links.
- HOVER: Card lifts 6px upward, shadow grows from a soft ambient (0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)) to a more pronounced drop shadow (0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.14)), and the Mint background brightens very slightly (toward #5DEBBF). Transition is smooth and quick (~180ms).

SCROLL REVEAL: Section headline fades up as the section enters the viewport. Then the four cards stagger in from 20px below their resting position, fading and translating up — top-left first, then top-right, then bottom-left, then bottom-right, each ~100ms after the previous. This wave pattern feels like the cards are being dealt.

ILLUSTRATED ICONS: The four icons from the asset set are placed top-left within each card (not centered), giving the cards a document-like, left-anchored readability. The icons are illustrated (not flat geometric), consistent with the brand's illustrated icon visual cue. Each icon has a white circular backdrop to ensure legibility on the Mint background.

NO AMBIENT MOTION in this section — it is deliberately still after the hero's kinetics, allowing parents to read and absorb the brand pillars without distraction.

RESPONSIVE: On tablet, cards remain 2 columns but card padding reduces to 24px. On mobile, single column, full-width cards.

SECTION 3 — GALLERY

This is the page's visual centerpiece and the most gallery-forward section. The clothes lead entirely. The section spans the full viewport width (edge-to-edge, no container padding on the sides), with only a narrow header block above the grid that is contained within the standard content max-width.

BACKGROUND: Pure white (#FFFFFF). The gallery tiles themselves provide all the color.

VERTICAL PADDING: 80px top (for the header block), then the gallery grid runs flush to the bottom edge of the section with 0 bottom padding — the grid's bottom edge IS the section's bottom edge, creating a clean, magazine-like termination.

HEADER BLOCK (left-aligned, NOT centered — breaking the symmetry of Section 2):
- Eyebrow pill: Fredoka One, 12px, uppercase, Playdate Coral (#FF6B5B) background, white text, 999px border-radius. Text: 'Fall / Winter Collection'. Left-aligned within the content container (max-width 1280px, 32px horizontal gutters).
- H2: Nunito 700, ~48px desktop / ~32px mobile, Muddy Trail (#3D3535), left-aligned, line-height 1.15, letter-spacing −0.01em. Text: 'This Season's Favorites'. Max-width 640px.
- Subheadline: DM Sans 400, 18px, Muddy Trail at 70% opacity, left-aligned, max-width 480px, line-height 1.6. Text: 'From muddy parks to birthday parties — we've got every occasion covered.' 12px below the H2.
- CTA: 'View All Collections' — rendered as a text link with a Sprout Mint (#4DDBB4) underline that grows from left to right on hover. DM Sans 500, 16px, Muddy Trail. Positioned to the RIGHT of the subheadline text on desktop (flex row: subheadline left, CTA right), creating an asymmetric, editorial header layout. On mobile, CTA moves below the subheadline.
- 40px gap between the header block and the gallery grid.

GALLERY GRID — ASYMMETRIC MASONRY-STYLE:
The 6 product items are laid out in a 3-column asymmetric grid on desktop:
- Column 1 (wide, ~40% of grid width): One tall tile (Adventure Anorak) spanning the full height of two rows — a large, dominant anchor image. Below it: one standard tile (Puddle-Jump Wellies).
- Column 2 (medium, ~30%): Two standard square tiles stacked — Explorer Dungarees (top), Stargazer Pyjama Set (bottom).
- Column 3 (medium, ~30%): Two tiles — Rainbow Stripe Tee (top, slightly taller), Cozy Fleece Hoodie (bottom, slightly shorter).
- The tall anchor tile in Column 1 is the visual anchor of the entire page — it is the largest single image on the page and reinforces the gallery-first layout family.
- Grid gap: 12px between all tiles.
- The grid is full-bleed (extends to the left and right viewport edges), with no container padding.

EACH GALLERY TILE:
- Image fills the tile completely (object-fit: cover).
- A product label panel is anchored to the bottom of each tile: a white pill/badge that floats ~12px above the tile's bottom edge (not full-width — a compact rounded badge, ~240px wide, centered horizontally within the tile). It contains:
  - Product name: Nunito 600, 15px, Muddy Trail.
  - Category tag: Fredoka One, 11px, Puddle Purple (#B57BFF) background, white text, 999px border-radius, inline pill. E.g., 'Outerwear'.
  - Age range: DM Sans 400, 12px, Muddy Trail at 60% opacity. E.g., '3–8 yrs'.
- HOVER: A Sprout Mint (#4DDBB4) color overlay fades in at 25% opacity over the image (giving it a fresh, brand-consistent tint). Simultaneously, the product label panel slides up from 12px below its resting position to its resting position (it starts slightly lower and rises into place on hover). Transition: ~220ms smooth ease.

DECORATIVE DETAIL: Two or three small Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D) dot blobs float behind the gallery grid at very low opacity (~15%), positioned in the upper-right and lower-left corners of the grid area. They drift very slowly downward as the user scrolls (parallax at ~15% scroll speed) — the 'floating behind gallery sections' decorative motif from the design system.

SCROLL REVEAL: Gallery tiles scale from 96% to 100% and fade in as the section enters the viewport. The large anchor tile (Column 1) arrives first, then the remaining tiles cascade in by column, left to right, each column starting ~120ms after the previous. Within each column, tiles stagger ~80ms apart.

RESPONSIVE: On tablet, 2-column grid — Column 1 tall anchor + Column 2 two stacked tiles, Column 3 items move below as a second row of 2. On mobile, single column, all tiles equal height (~280px), scrolling vertically.

SECTION 4 — STATS

Full-bleed Playdate Coral (#FF6B5B) background — a dramatic, saturated color band that breaks the page's rhythm entirely. This section is the boldest color moment after the hero, and it arrives as a visual shock that re-energizes the scroll journey. Edge-to-edge, no border radius, no wave edge — a hard, confident horizontal band.

VERTICAL PADDING: 72px top and bottom on desktop, 56px on mobile. Compact and punchy — this section doesn't linger.

HEADER BLOCK (centered):
- Eyebrow pill: Fredoka One, 12px, uppercase, white background, Playdate Coral text, 999px border-radius. Text: 'Sproutly by the Numbers'. Centered. The white pill on coral background is a deliberate inversion of the usual pill treatment — it pops.
- H2: Nunito 700, ~36px desktop / ~24px mobile, white, centered, line-height 1.2, letter-spacing −0.01em. Text: 'A Brand Families Come Back To'. Max-width 560px, centered. 24px below the eyebrow pill.
- 40px gap between H2 and the stat grid.

STAT GRID: 4 columns on desktop, 2×2 on tablet, single column on mobile. Max-width 1000px, centered. Column gap: 32px.

EACH STAT ITEM (no card surface — items float directly on the coral background):
- Stat number: Nunito 900, ~72px desktop / ~52px mobile, white. This is the dominant typographic element — the numbers are enormous relative to the surrounding copy, creating an oversized numeral effect. E.g., '50,000+', '4.9 / 5', '100%', '3 Seasons'.
- Stat unit label (where applicable, e.g., the '/' in '4.9 / 5' or the unit 'Seasons'): Fredoka One, 14px, Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D). This creates a subtle color accent within the white numeral — the Fredoka One's bubbly character adds a sticker-like quality.
- Stat description: DM Sans 400, 15px, white at 85% opacity, line-height 1.5, centered beneath the numeral. E.g., 'Happy families dressed by Sproutly'.
- A thin white horizontal rule (1px, 40% opacity) separates each stat item from its neighbor on desktop (vertical dividers between columns). On mobile, these become horizontal rules between stacked items.

SCROLL REVEAL & SIGNATURE MOTION: As the section enters the viewport, the four stat numbers count up from zero to their final values simultaneously — a fast, satisfying count-up animation (approximately 1.2 seconds, easing out so the final value snaps into place). The description text fades in as each number completes its count. This is the section's kinetic highlight and one of the page's most satisfying scroll moments.

AMBIENT: No looped ambient motion in this section — the count-up is a one-time triggered event. After it completes, the section is deliberately still, letting the numbers speak.

NO HOVER STATES on stat items — they are purely informational, not interactive.

RESPONSIVE: The enormous numeral scale reduces gracefully on mobile (~52px) but remains the dominant element. On mobile, each stat is full-width with a horizontal rule between items.

SECTION 5 — TESTIMONIALS

Background: Soft Pebble (#F2F0ED) — returning to the gentle off-white after the Coral band, creating a warm, quiet landing. This section has the most ambient, unhurried energy on the page — it's where parents feel seen.

VERTICAL PADDING: 96px top and bottom on desktop, 72px on mobile. Generous — this section breathes.

HEADER BLOCK (centered):
- Eyebrow pill: Fredoka One, 12px, uppercase, Sprout Mint (#4DDBB4) background, white text, 999px border-radius. Text: 'Parent Stories'. Centered.
- H2: Nunito 700, ~40px desktop / ~28px mobile, Muddy Trail (#3D3535), centered, line-height 1.2. Text: 'What Families Are Saying'. Max-width 480px, centered. 32px below the eyebrow.
- 48px gap between H2 and the testimonial card row.

TESTIMONIAL CARDS: 3-column row on desktop, single-column stacked on mobile. Each card is a distinct white (#FFFFFF) rounded rectangle (border-radius 20px) with 32px padding on all sides. Cards are NOT identical in height — they reflect natural content height, creating a slightly staggered visual baseline that feels organic rather than templated. Card gap: 24px.

EACH CARD INTERIOR:
- Oversized Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D) quotation mark: Fredoka One or Nunito 900, ~80px, positioned in the top-left corner of the card, slightly overlapping the card's top edge (extending ~16px above the card's top boundary). This is a deliberate decorative overflow — the quote mark is a structural decoration, not just an icon. It anchors each card visually and adds the 'sticker' energy of the brand.
- Quote body: DM Sans 400, 16px, Muddy Trail (#3D3535), line-height 1.65, italic. The quote text begins ~12px below the quote mark's baseline. E.g., '"I've tried every kids' brand out there. Sproutly is the only one where the colours haven't faded after a term of school runs and muddy weekends."'
- Reviewer name: Nunito 700, 15px, Muddy Trail, 20px below the quote body. E.g., 'Mia, mum of three'.
- Location: DM Sans 400, 13px, Muddy Trail at 55% opacity. E.g., 'Bristol, UK'. 4px below the name.
- A 3px Sprout Mint (#4DDBB4) left-border accent runs the full height of the card on the left edge — a subtle structural detail that ties the cards to the brand palette.

SCROLL REVEAL: Cards slide up from 24px below their resting position and fade in, staggered left to right — left card first, middle card ~120ms later, right card ~240ms later. The Sunshine Squeal quote marks scale in with a slight overshoot (a gentle bounce ease, overshooting to 110% then settling to 100%) just before the card text appears — giving the quote marks a 'stamp' entrance that feels playful and brand-consistent.

NO AMBIENT MOTION in this section — it is deliberately still and warm after the kinetic stats section.

RESPONSIVE: On tablet, 2-column grid (first two cards in row 1, third card below, left-aligned). On mobile, single column, cards full-width. The oversized quote mark overflow is preserved on all breakpoints.

SECTION 6 — CTA CLOSE

Background: Adventure Sky (#3AABF0) full-bleed — returning to the hero's primary brand blue for a confident, bookending close. The section feels like a warm callback to the page's opening energy, signaling arrival and completion.

PATTERN OVERLAY: The repeating pattern asset (tiny stars, leaves, and small cartoon animals) tiles seamlessly across the entire section background at ~12% opacity in white — it floats above the Adventure Sky base color, visible but never competing with the copy. The pattern tiles drift very slowly leftward in a continuous, barely-perceptible horizontal scroll (~1px per second) — a gentle ambient motion that makes the background feel alive without being distracting. This is the 'background texture feels playful and brand-consistent' intent from the asset brief, executed as a living surface.

VERTICAL PADDING: 96px top and bottom on desktop, 72px on mobile. The section is generous — the single CTA moment deserves room to breathe and feel like a destination, not a footer.

COMPOSITION: Fully centered, single column. Max-width 640px, centered within the full-bleed section.

CONTENT STACK (top to bottom, all centered):
- Eyebrow pill: Fredoka One, 12px, uppercase, white background, Adventure Sky text (or Puddle Purple #B57BFF background with white text for contrast variety), 999px border-radius. Text: 'Join the Club'. Centered.
- H2: Nunito 800, ~48px desktop / ~32px mobile, white, centered, line-height 1.15, letter-spacing −0.01em. Text: 'Get Early Access, Exclusive Drops & 10% Off Your First Order'. The '10% Off' phrase can be visually emphasized with Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D) color on those specific words — a typographic highlight that draws the eye to the value proposition. Max-width 560px.
- Subheadline: DM Sans 400, 18px, white at 85% opacity, centered, line-height 1.6. Text: 'Join thousands of parents who never miss a new Sproutly collection.' Max-width 440px. 16px below the H2.
- CTA Button: 'Join Sproutly Club' — large pill button (999px border-radius), white background, Adventure Sky text (DM Sans 600, 17px). Generous padding: 18px vertical / 40px horizontal. Centered. 32px below the subheadline.
  - HOVER: Button background shifts to Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D), text color shifts to Muddy Trail (#3D3535) — a warm, playful color swap that feels like a reward for hovering. Scale lifts to 103%. Transition: ~180ms.
  - AMBIENT PULSE: The button pulses very gently on a 3-second loop — a barely-perceptible scale oscillation between 100% and 102% — drawing the eye without being aggressive. This is the 'pulsing CTA' ambient motion from the design system.

DECORATIVE DETAIL: Two small Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D) dot blobs (irregular, ~32–48px) are placed — one in the upper-left of the section and one in the lower-right — floating above the pattern layer but behind the text. They are static (no animation) to keep the section's motion focused on the pattern drift and button pulse.

SCROLL REVEAL: The headline fades in and scales from 95% to 100% as the section enters the viewport. The subheadline fades up a beat after the headline settles. The CTA button scales from 90% to 100% a beat after the subheadline, then immediately begins its ambient pulse loop.

RESPONSIVE: Fully centered single column on all breakpoints. Headline font size scales down gracefully to ~28px on small mobile. Button remains full pill shape but reduces horizontal padding to 28px on mobile. Pattern overlay and ambient drift are preserved on all breakpoints.

NO SECTION BELOW THIS — the page ends here. The footer (outside this section scope) sits immediately below on a Muddy Trail (#3D3535) dark background, creating a strong final contrast that closes the page decisively.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
## Collections Page — Full Visual Design Direction

### Page Role & Tone
This is a gallery-first browsing page for parents discovering Sproutly kids' clothing. The layout must feel like stepping into a bright, well-organised children's boutique — full of energy, easy to navigate, and impossible not to linger in. Every section should feel like a new room, not a repeated template. The clothes lead; copy supports.

---

### Section Sequence & Rhythm Variation
1. **Page Header** — Full-bleed Adventure Sky blue panel with oversized display headline breaking the grid. Sparse, bold, directional. Sets the energy.
2. **Feature Grid (Shop by Category)** — Dense, tappable 6-card grid on Sproutly Cloud white. Icon-led cards with Sprout Mint fills. Compact and purposeful.
3. **Gallery (This Season's Must-Haves)** — The page's visual centrepiece. A large asymmetric masonry-style grid of product photography dominates. Minimal copy. Full-bleed warmth with Soft Pebble background. This is the signature moment section.
4. **Item Grid (Shop by Age)** — Three wide horizontal age-band cards on Soft Pebble, each with an illustrated child figure. Asymmetric split: illustration left, copy right. Calm and reassuring after the gallery's density.
5. **Story Block (Materials Promise)** — A Sunshine Squeal yellow full-bleed band. Left-anchored pull-quote-style body text, with a large decorative leaf/leaf-texture motif bleeding off the right edge. Warm and editorial.
6. **CTA Close (Join the Club)** — Adventure Sky blue full-bleed panel with a seamless clothing-item pattern as the background texture, large centered headline, and a single bold Playdate Coral CTA button. Energetic and conclusive.

The page alternates between high-density visual sections (2, 3) and calmer, more editorial sections (4, 5), with the CTA close bringing the energy back up. This creates a breathe-in / breathe-out rhythm that keeps parents engaged without overwhelming them.

---

### Signature Moment
**The Gallery Section (Section 3) is the page's signature moment.** A large asymmetric masonry grid of six product images fills the full viewport width with no gutters between the two largest hero images. The top row holds two full-bleed images side by side — one spanning ~60% width, one ~40% — both at roughly 480px tall. Below, four smaller cards fill a four-column row. Product name and price float as a semi-transparent Muddy Trail pill overlaid at the bottom-left of each card, appearing on hover. The eyebrow label "Fall / Winter 2025" is set in Fredoka One, rendered in Playdate Coral, and positioned as a vertical rotated label running up the left edge of the grid — a typographic stunt that turns the season label into a structural spine. This move is unmistakably friendly-consumer-app: the clothes are enormous, the type is playful, and the layout feels more like a kids' magazine spread than an e-commerce grid.

**Signature Motion Moment:** As the gallery section scrolls into view, the two top hero images slide in from opposite sides (left panel from the left, right panel from the right) and settle into position with a gentle elastic ease, as if the clothes are arriving on stage. The four smaller cards below stagger-fade upward a beat later, one by one left to right. The vertical "Fall / Winter 2025" Coral label spins into its rotated position with a quick snap-rotate, landing just as the cards finish loading. This entrance sequence is the most kinetically rich moment on the page.

---

### Color & Surface Usage Across Sections
- **Section 1 (Header):** Adventure Sky (#3AABF0) full-bleed background. White headline text. Puddle Purple eyebrow pill.
- **Section 2 (Category Grid):** Sproutly Cloud (#FFFFFF) background. Sprout Mint (#4DDBB4) icon background circles. Muddy Trail body text. Puddle Purple age-range tag pills.
- **Section 3 (Gallery):** Soft Pebble (#F2F0ED) background behind the grid. Images fill their cells with no tinting. Playdate Coral vertical label. Sunshine Squeal dot motifs floating behind the grid as decorative blobs.
- **Section 4 (Age Grid):** Soft Pebble (#F2F0ED) background. Three cards in Sproutly Cloud (#FFFFFF) with Sprout Mint left accent border. Muddy Trail text. Puddle Purple eyebrow pill.
- **Section 5 (Materials Story):** Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D) full-bleed background. Muddy Trail body text (high contrast on yellow). Playdate Coral CTA button.
- **Section 6 (CTA Close):** Adventure Sky (#3AABF0) full-bleed background. White headline. Playdate Coral CTA button. Clothing-pattern overlay at low opacity.

No two adjacent sections share the same background surface. The page never settles into a predictable alternation — Soft Pebble appears twice but is separated by the yellow Story Block.

---

### Typographic Hierarchy & Expressive Moves
- **H1 (Section 1):** Nunito 900 weight, ~72–80px display size, white, tight letter-spacing (−0.01em). Sentence case. Runs across nearly the full width of the header, deliberately oversized to fill the blue panel.
- **H2 (Sections 2, 3, 4, 5, 6):** Nunito 700, 36–42px, Muddy Trail (or white on blue/yellow panels). Sentence case.
- **H3 (Card titles):** Nunito 600, 18–20px, Muddy Trail.
- **Body:** DM Sans 400, 16–18px, Muddy Trail at 70% opacity for meta labels, full opacity for body paragraphs.
- **Eyebrow labels:** Fredoka One, 12–14px, uppercase, set in Puddle Purple on white backgrounds, white on colored backgrounds — always in a pill with a 4px border-radius and appropriate background tint.
- **Accent/badge text:** Fredoka One, 12px, for age-range tags, price labels, and the vertical season label.
- **Signature typographic move:** The vertical "Fall / Winter 2025" Fredoka One label in Playdate Coral running up the left side of the gallery grid, rotated 90° counter-clockwise, at ~18px. It functions as a structural spine, not a decoration.

---

### Density & Whitespace Logic
- Sections 1 and 6 are deliberately sparse — the color and type do the work, whitespace amplifies the boldness.
- Sections 2 and 3 are dense — 6-card grids and full-bleed masonry images fill the viewport.
- Sections 4 and 5 provide mid-page breathing room with generous padding (80–100px vertical) and open layouts.
- Card padding is consistent at 20–24px internal. Section vertical padding: 64px on desktop, 48px on mobile.

---

### Motion Design

**On-Load Arc (Section 1 — Page Header):**
- The Adventure Sky background fades in over ~0.4s as the page loads.
- The Puddle Purple eyebrow pill slides down from above and settles, a beat before the headline.
- The headline "Find the Perfect Outfit for Every Adventure" reveals word by word with a quick stagger — each word fades and slides up from 12px below, flowing left to right, completing in about 0.6s.
- The subheadline fades in a beat after the headline settles.
- A subtle slow-moving gradient shimmer sweeps left-to-right across the blue background on loop — like light moving across fabric — giving the header an ambient, living quality.

**Scroll-Triggered Reveals:**
- **Section 2 (Category Grid):** The headline fades in first, then the six category cards stagger-scale up from 95% to 100% with a fade, left to right, two rows of three, with each card arriving about 80ms after the last.
- **Section 3 (Gallery — Signature):** Described in the signature moment above. Two hero images slide in from opposite sides; four smaller cards stagger-fade upward; vertical label snaps into rotation.
- **Section 4 (Age Grid):** The illustration slides in from the left as the three age-band cards fade and slide up from the right, staggered top to bottom.
- **Section 5 (Materials Story):** The Sunshine Squeal panel wipes in from left to right (a horizontal reveal) as it enters the viewport, then the body text fades in over the settled background.
- **Section 6 (CTA Close):** The background pattern fades in first, then the headline drops in from above, then the CTA button bounces in with a playful overshoot-and-settle (like a rubber ball landing).

**Hover & Focus Affordances:**
- **Category cards (Section 2):** On hover, the Sprout Mint icon background circle scales up to 110% and the card lifts 4px with a soft shadow. The card border transitions from transparent to a 2px Sprout Mint stroke. Smooth 150ms ease.
- **Gallery product cards (Section 3):** On hover, the product name/price pill slides up from hidden to visible at the card's bottom-left. The image scales very slightly (to 103%) within its container with overflow hidden — a gentle zoom. 200ms ease.
- **Age-band cards (Section 4):** On hover, the left Sprout Mint accent border thickens from 4px to 8px and the card background shifts from white to a very pale Sprout Mint tint. 150ms ease.
- **CTA buttons:** On hover, Playdate Coral buttons lighten slightly and lift 3px with a shadow. On focus, a clear 3px white outline ring appears outside the button. 120ms ease.
- **Nav links:** Underline grows from 0 width to full width from left to right on hover. 150ms ease.

**Ambient Looped Motion:**
- The Adventure Sky header (Section 1) has a slow, continuous gradient shimmer sweeping left-to-right on a ~4s loop — subtle, like light on a puddle.
- The Sunshine Squeal decorative dot/blob motifs behind the gallery (Section 3) drift very slowly — each blob moves 6–8px up and down on a 5–7s staggered sine-wave loop, giving the gallery a gentle floating quality.
- The CTA section (Section 6) clothing-pattern background drifts at a very slow diagonal pace — barely perceptible, like the items are gently floating — on a continuous loop.
- The "Join Sproutly Club" CTA button in Section 6 has a soft pulse — a subtle scale breathe (100% → 102% → 100%) on a 2.5s loop — drawing the eye without being aggressive.

---

### Responsive Behavior
- **Desktop (≥1280px):** Full masonry gallery with two large hero images top row. Six-column category grid. Three-column age-band cards side by side.
- **Tablet (768–1279px):** Gallery collapses to a 2-column grid with equal-width cells. Category grid becomes 3×2. Age-band cards stack vertically.
- **Mobile (<768px):** Gallery becomes a single-column scroll with full-width cards. Category grid becomes 2×3. Age-band cards are full-width stacked. The vertical season label in the gallery repositions to a horizontal eyebrow above the grid. Header headline reduces to ~40px. All section padding reduces to 40px vertical.

---

### Fit Within Shared Design System
This page uses every palette color purposefully, all three typefaces in their defined roles, and the rounded-card / illustrated-icon / soft-color-block visual language of the Friendly Consumer App aesthetic. The gallery-first layout family is honored by making Section 3 the undeniable visual center of gravity — the clothes genuinely dominate. The page feels like a natural sibling to the Home page (which shares the Adventure Sky hero and Fredoka One eyebrow language) while having its own distinct composition anchored by the masonry gallery and the vertical season label signature.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
## Our Story & Team — Page-Level Design Direction

### Page Role & Emotional Arc
This is the brand heart page — editorial in soul, gallery-first in structure. The page must feel like a handwritten letter from the founders, not a corporate About Us. Every section should feel warm, personal, and slightly imperfect in the best way — like a family photo album with great art direction. The rhythm moves from bold arrival → unhurried narrative → value declaration → human faces → milestone march → community invitation.

### Signature Moment: The Oversized Pull-Quote Splash (Section 2)
The page's defining visual move lives in the Story Block (Section 2). A single sentence from the founding narrative — "Two parents. One sketchy idea. Fifty thousand families." — is set in Fredoka One at enormous display scale (clocking in at roughly 96–120px on desktop), rendered in Playdate Coral (#FF6B5B), and allowed to bleed past the right edge of the content column, sitting partially behind the kitchen-table illustration. The text is NOT a heading — it's a typographic object, a sticker-like stamp that dominates the upper-right quadrant of the section. This is the moment a visitor stops scrolling and registers that this brand has a real personality. It belongs to the Friendly Consumer App aesthetic because it uses type as illustration — a rounded, bubbly, crayon-energy gesture that mirrors the brand's visual language at full amplitude. It is not centered, not constrained, and not polite.

### Signature Motion Moment: The Pull-Quote Ink-In (Section 2)
Tied directly to the signature visual, as the story block scrolls into view, the oversized pull-quote text appears to "ink in" from left to right — each word fading and scaling up from 80% to 100% in a staggered cascade, with a very slight warm-to-vivid color transition (starting at a desaturated coral and arriving at full #FF6B5B). The illustration beside it drifts up 12px from its initial resting position simultaneously. Together they feel like the story is being written in real time.

### Section Sequence & Rhythm
1. **Page Header** — Full-bleed Adventure Sky (#3AABF0) background. Masthead-style, type-dominant, asymmetric. Dense arrival.
2. **Story Block** — White surface, illustration left, narrative right, oversized pull-quote bleeding off-grid. Signature moment lives here. Unhurried, spacious.
3. **Feature Grid (Values)** — Soft Pebble (#F2F0ED) background. Three tall cards with Sprout Mint icon fills. Compact but airy. Structural.
4. **Item Grid (Team)** — White surface. Four portrait cards in a 2×2 grid (desktop), illustrated avatars prominent. Warm and personal.
5. **Timeline** — Adventure Sky (#3AABF0) full-bleed panel. Vertical spine with Playdate Coral (#FF6B5B) nodes. Milestone-march rhythm. Dense.
6. **CTA Close** — Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D) full-bleed block. Centered editorial close. Illustration above. Joyful.

The alternation is: saturated blue → white (signature) → off-white → white → saturated blue → saturated yellow. No two adjacent sections share the same surface. The page never feels like a grey-on-white SaaS template.

### Color & Surface Logic
- Adventure Sky anchors the page open and close (Sections 1 and 5), bookending the narrative with brand confidence.
- Sunshine Squeal closes the page — the warmest, most joyful color saved for the final emotional beat.
- Playdate Coral is the typographic hero color — used for the pull-quote splash, timeline node markers, and stat accents.
- Puddle Purple (#B57BFF) appears exclusively on eyebrow label pills across all sections, providing a consistent wayfinding signal without competing with the section backgrounds.
- Sprout Mint fills the value card icon backgrounds and hover states on team portrait cards.
- Muddy Trail (#3D3535) is the text color on all white/off-white surfaces; white text on all saturated color panels.

### Typographic Hierarchy
- H1 (Section 1): Nunito ExtraBold 900, ~56–64px desktop / 36px mobile, white, tight letter-spacing, left-aligned, 2-line max.
- H2 section titles: Nunito Bold 700, ~40–48px desktop / 28px mobile, color varies by surface.
- H3 card/item titles: Nunito SemiBold 600, ~20–22px.
- Body: DM Sans Regular 400, 17px, 1.65 line-height, 65ch max-width.
- Eyebrow labels: Fredoka One, 13px, uppercase tracking 0.08em, Puddle Purple text on white pill with subtle border.
- Pull-quote / accent type: Fredoka One, 96–120px desktop, Playdate Coral, bleeds off-grid.
- Timeline year labels: Fredoka One, 28px, white with Playdate Coral node dot.
- CTA buttons: DM Sans Medium 500, rounded-full, primary = Adventure Sky fill / white text; secondary = white fill / Adventure Sky text.

### Density & Whitespace Logic
- Section 1 (header): Tight — large type fills the panel. Minimal breathing room. Arrival energy.
- Section 2 (story): Generous — wide margins, tall section, illustration given room to breathe. The pull-quote creates visual density in one quadrant only.
- Section 3 (values): Medium — three cards with comfortable internal padding, icon + title + body, no crowding.
- Section 4 (team): Medium — 2×2 grid, portrait illustration prominent per card, bio text kept short.
- Section 5 (timeline): Dense vertically — milestones stack with a clear spine, but each node has breathing room left/right.
- Section 6 (CTA): Sparse — illustration above, centered text below, two CTAs. Room to exhale.

### Motion Design — Full Page Arc

**On-Load Arc (Section 1):**
- The Adventure Sky background floods in from the left edge as a color wash over the first 0.4s.
- The eyebrow pill drops in from above and settles a beat before the headline.
- The H1 headline reveals word by word, each word sliding up from below and fading in, staggered by roughly half a beat per word.
- The subheadline fades in softly a full beat after the headline settles.
- A cluster of three small Sunshine Squeal blob/dot decorations in the top-right corner of the header slowly drift upward in a gentle looping float (ambient, begins immediately, loops forever at a very slow pace — roughly a 6-second cycle).

**Scroll-Triggered Reveals:**
- Section 2: Illustration drifts up 12px and fades in as the section enters viewport. Pull-quote inks in word by word (signature motion moment — see above). Body text paragraph fades in a beat after.
- Section 3: The three value cards slide up from 24px below their final position and fade in with a stagger — left card first, then center, then right, each separated by a short beat.
- Section 4: Team portrait cards scale from 96% to 100% and fade in as a group, with a slight stagger (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right).
- Section 5: Timeline nodes animate in sequence from top to bottom — each Playdate Coral dot pulses once (scale 1 → 1.3 → 1) as it appears, then the connecting line draws downward to the next node. The milestone text fades in immediately after its node appears.
- Section 6: Illustration bounces in gently (a small scale-up from 95% with a soft overshoot), then the headline and subheadline fade up, then the two CTA buttons appear together.

**Hover & Focus Affordances:**
- Value cards (Section 3): Card lifts 6px, shadow deepens from subtle to medium, icon background transitions from Sprout Mint to a slightly deeper mint. Transition is quick (~180ms).
- Team portrait cards (Section 4): Card lifts 4px, a thin Sprout Mint border appears around the card, the illustrated avatar scales up very slightly (1.04×). Smooth ~200ms transition.
- CTA buttons: Primary button darkens slightly (Adventure Sky → 10% darker), scales to 1.03×. Secondary button background fills with Adventure Sky at 10% opacity. Both have a clear focus ring in Puddle Purple for keyboard navigation.
- Timeline nodes (Section 5): On hover, the Playdate Coral dot pulses once and the milestone text briefly bolds (weight transition from 400 to 600 on DM Sans).

**Ambient Looped Motion:**
- Section 1: Three floating blob/dot decorations in Sunshine Squeal drift slowly upward and back in a gentle sine-wave loop. Never distracting, always alive.
- Section 6: The illustration of children playing has a very slow parallax drift — as the user scrolls through the section, the illustration moves at 60% of the scroll speed, creating a gentle sense of depth. The two CTA buttons have a subtle breathing pulse (shadow gently expands and contracts on a ~3s loop) to draw the eye without shouting.

### Responsive Behavior
- Desktop (≥1280px): Full asymmetric layouts, pull-quote bleeds off-grid, 2×2 team grid, timeline as a vertical spine with alternating left/right content.
- Tablet (768–1279px): Story block stacks illustration above text, pull-quote scales to ~72px and stays right-aligned. Team grid stays 2×2. Timeline remains vertical spine.
- Mobile (<768px): All sections stack vertically. Pull-quote scales to ~48px, still Playdate Coral, still right-aligned. Team grid becomes 1×4. Timeline collapses to a single left-aligned spine with nodes on the left. CTA buttons stack vertically, full-width.

### Design System Fit
This page uses the full Sproutly palette expressively — not just as backgrounds but as typographic color, structural color, and emotional color. The rounded-card UI language from the design system appears in value cards and team cards. Fredoka One is used at its maximum expressive amplitude (the pull-quote), not just in small badge moments. Nunito's rounded warmth carries the editorial headings. DM Sans keeps the body copy grounded and readable. The page feels like a natural part of the Sproutly site while being the most personal and story-driven page in the set.

SECTION 1 — PAGE HEADER (page_header type)

Signature Motion Moment — Pull-Quote Ink-In: As the section enters the viewport, the pull-quote words ink in from left to right — each word fades from 0 to 1 opacity and scales from 85% to 100%, staggered by roughly one beat per word. Eyebrow: Fredoka One, 13px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.08em. Puddle Purple (#B57BFF) text on white pill with 1px Puddle Purple border. Left-aligned above the headline.

Headline (H2): Nunito Bold 700, ~44px desktop / 28px mobile. Muddy Trail (#3D3535). Text reads: 'Meet the People Behind the Label.' Left-aligned. Sits 16px below eyebrow.

Team Portrait Cards: Each card is a rounded rectangle (border-radius 20px), white surface with a very subtle shadow (6px blur, 10% opacity). Internal padding: 32px. Cards are approximately 560px wide × 240px tall on desktop (landscape orientation).

Milestone Title (H3): Nunito SemiBold 600, 18px, Muddy Trail (#3D3535). Below the year label, 6px gap.

Milestone Body: DM Sans Regular 400, 15px, line-height 1.6, Muddy Trail at 75% opacity. Max 42ch.

## FAQ Page — Sproutly Design Plan

### Page Role & Tone
This is the trust-building support page — a parent's pre-purchase safety net. The design must feel genuinely warm and human, not like a legal document or a sterile help center. It should carry the same joyful Sproutly energy as the rest of the site while being scannable and frictionless. Every design decision reinforces the message: "Real people made this for you."

### Section Sequence & Rhythm
The page opens with a bold, full-bleed page header that makes an immediate tonal promise — playful, not corporate. Four FAQ accordion sections follow, each with its own color surface and typographic personality so they read as distinct chapters rather than one monotonous list. The page closes with a warm contact block that feels like a friendly handshake. Rhythm alternates: dense (header) → open accordion (Sizing) → tighter accordion with inline chart (Materials) → open accordion (Delivery) → accent-blocked accordion (Sustainability) → warm card cluster (Contact). This creates a push-pull of density and breathing room across the scroll.

### Signature Moment
**The Oversized Rotated Category Label System** — on every FAQ section, the eyebrow text (e.g., "Sizing & Fit", "Materials & Care") is rendered in Fredoka One at a very large scale (~120–140px) and rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise, running vertically along the left edge of the section like a chapter tab in a kid's illustrated encyclopedia. These vertical labels are rendered in the section's accent color and sit partially behind the accordion content, creating a layered, off-grid depth effect. This is the signature visual move: it transforms a standard FAQ layout into something that feels like a beautifully designed children's reference book. It is calibrated to the friendly_consumer_app aesthetic — playful, bold, and human — without being chaotic. On mobile, the rotated labels collapse to horizontal eyebrow pills.

### Signature Motion Moment
**The Accordion Open Burst** — when a parent clicks any FAQ accordion item to expand it, the answer panel doesn't just slide down. It expands with a quick, springy "pop" — scaling very slightly from 98% to 100% width while the text fades in from 0 to full opacity. Simultaneously, the rotated vertical eyebrow label for that section pulses once with a gentle brightness flash (like a sticker catching light), reinforcing that this section is "alive." This motion is calibrated to be delightful without being distracting — a single burst per interaction, never looping.

### On-Load Arc
The page header headline ("Questions? We've Got Answers.") drops in from above — the large display text falls into place over roughly half a second, landing with a subtle overshoot bounce that feels like a rubber stamp. A beat after the headline settles, the subheadline fades in from below. A further beat later, the illustrated icon or decorative blob motif behind the header drifts into its resting position from slightly off-screen right. The first FAQ section's vertical rotated label slides in from the left edge as the user's eye naturally moves down the page.

### Scroll-Triggered Reveals
Each FAQ section (sections 2–5) enters the viewport with a staggered slide-up: the rotated vertical label slides in from the left while the accordion items cascade in from below, each item offset by a short delay after the previous. The contact block (section 6) fades in as a unified block — no stagger — giving it a calm, settled arrival that contrasts with the more energetic FAQ reveals above.

### Hover & Focus Affordances
- FAQ accordion items: on hover, the row background shifts from white to a very light tint of the section's accent color, and a small arrow or chevron icon rotates 90 degrees. On keyboard focus, a 2px solid accent-color border appears around the row.
- Open accordion items: the active-state border on the left edge of the expanded panel is rendered in Puddle Purple (#B57BFF) at 3px — matching the design system spec.
- Contact channel cards: lift 4px with a soft shadow deepening on hover, and the illustrated icon inside scales up 5%.
- Primary CTA button: lifts 3px, shadow deepens, and the button background shifts one stop warmer (coral deepens slightly).

### Ambient / Looped Motion
- Small Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D) dot/blob decorative motifs float behind the page header and the sustainability section — these breathe very slowly (scaling between 100% and 103% over 4 seconds, looping), giving the page a gentle living quality.
- The vertical rotated eyebrow labels have a very subtle shimmer/gloss sweep that passes across them every 8 seconds — like a sticker catching light — reinforcing the sticker-energy of the brand.

### Color & Surface Logic
- Section 1 (Header): Adventure Sky (#3AABF0) full-bleed background — bold brand arrival.
- Section 2 (Sizing FAQ): Sproutly Cloud (#FFFFFF) background, Sprout Mint (#4DDBB4) vertical label.
- Section 3 (Materials FAQ): Soft Pebble (#F2F0ED) background, Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D) vertical label.
- Section 4 (Delivery FAQ): Sproutly Cloud (#FFFFFF) background, Playdate Coral (#FF6B5B) vertical label.
- Section 5 (Sustainability FAQ): Sprout Mint (#4DDBB4) full-bleed background, white vertical label — the one saturated non-header section, creating a color surprise mid-page.
- Section 6 (Contact): Soft Pebble (#F2F0ED) background with Muddy Trail (#3D3535) text — warm and grounded close.

### Typography Hierarchy
- H1 (page header): Nunito 800, ~64–72px on desktop, ~40px on mobile, Sproutly Cloud (#FFFFFF) on Adventure Sky.
- Section headlines (H2): Nunito 700, ~36–40px, Muddy Trail (#3D3535), sentence case.
- Vertical eyebrow labels: Fredoka One, ~120–140px, rotated 90° CCW, section accent color, 40% opacity to allow layering.
- Accordion item titles (H3): Nunito SemiBold 600, ~18–20px, Muddy Trail.
- Accordion body text: DM Sans Regular 400, 16–17px, Muddy Trail at 70% opacity, line-height 1.65.
- Eyebrow pills (horizontal, mobile): Fredoka One, 12–13px, accent color on white pill with rounded corners.
- Contact card labels: DM Sans Medium 500, 15px, Muddy Trail.

### Grid & Spacing
Desktop uses a 12-column grid with 24px gutters and 80px horizontal page margins. FAQ sections use 10 of 12 columns for the accordion content, with the remaining space on the left consumed by the rotated vertical label. Vertical section padding: 80px top/bottom for FAQ sections, 100px for header and contact block. On mobile (single column), padding reduces to 48px top/bottom, vertical labels become horizontal pills.

### Responsive Behavior
- Desktop (≥1024px): Full rotated vertical label system, 10-col accordion, size chart displayed inline beside FAQ items.
- Tablet (768–1023px): Rotated labels shrink to ~80px, accordion spans full width minus label gutter.
- Mobile (<768px): Rotated labels become horizontal Fredoka One eyebrow pills above section headlines. Accordion items stack full-width. Size chart scrolls horizontally inside a scroll container.

### Design System Fit
This page uses all eight palette colors — the header and sustainability section use full-bleed accent surfaces; Puddle Purple appears on active accordion borders; Sunshine Squeal powers the sustainability section's decorative icon and floating blobs; Soft Pebble creates the alternating section rhythm. Typography strictly follows the system: Nunito for headings, DM Sans for body, Fredoka One for labels and badges. The rotated label system is the page's unique contribution to the site's visual language — it's not used elsewhere but feels native to the brand's illustrated-book energy.

## Join Sproutly Club — Page-Level Design Direction

### Page Role & Emotional Arc
This is the conversion close for Sproutly. The page must feel like a warm, celebratory invitation — not a sign-up funnel. Every design decision should reinforce the feeling that joining is a joyful, obvious thing to do. The page moves from invitation (hero) → proof of value (benefits grid) → social trust (testimonials) → friction removal (FAQ) → the act itself (sign-up form) → graceful exit (secondary CTA). The rhythm alternates between high-energy, color-saturated moments and quieter, content-dense passages so the parent never feels overwhelmed.

### Section Sequence & Rhythm
1. **Hero** — Full-bleed Adventure Sky blue panel, oversized display type, illustrated membership badge floating large and proud. High energy, sparse copy, single CTA. This is the loudest moment.
2. **Feature Grid** — Soft Pebble background, six benefit cards in a 3×2 grid with illustrated icons. Medium density, scannable, friendly. Energy drops slightly to let content breathe.
3. **Testimonials** — White background, three quote cards in a horizontal row with Sunshine Squeal quote marks at oversized scale. Light, human, conversational.
4. **FAQ** — Alternating Soft Pebble / White accordion rows. Dense but calm. Typography-led, minimal decoration.
5. **Sign-Up Form** — THE SIGNATURE MOMENT. A full-bleed confetti-pattern panel in Adventure Sky with the form centered inside a large white rounded card. The section feels like a celebration is already beginning. Maximum warmth, zero friction.
6. **Graceful Exit CTA** — Minimal, centered, white background. Two secondary text-style CTAs. Deliberately quiet after the form's celebration energy.

### Signature Visual Moment
**Section 5 — The Celebration Form Panel.** The sign-up section breaks the page's alternating-background logic with a full-bleed Adventure Sky panel tiled with the confetti pattern (tiny stars, sprouts, dots in Sprout Mint, Sunshine Squeal, Playdate Coral, and Puddle Purple). The white sign-up card floats inside this panel with generous rounded corners (24px+), a soft drop shadow, and the Fredoka One eyebrow "You're Almost In" rendered in Playdate Coral at an oversized pill label scale. The headline in Nunito 800 at ~40px is centered and warm. The form fields are clean white with Adventure Sky focus rings. The submit CTA button is Playdate Coral, large, rounded, and full-width inside the card. This moment is unmistakably Sproutly — a child's birthday party energy applied to a conversion form.

### Signature Motion Moment
**The Celebration Form Panel Entrance (Section 5):** As the sign-up section scrolls into view, the confetti pattern elements (stars, sprouts, dots) animate in from random positions across the panel — a brief burst of illustrated confetti that settles into the tiled background over about 600ms. The white form card scales up from 95% to 100% with a gentle ease-out, as if it's popping into existence. The submit button then pulses once — a single soft scale breath — to draw the eye. This is the page's kinetic climax, timed to feel like the moment you arrive at a party.

### On-Load Arc (Hero)
- The Adventure Sky background floods in as a fast color wash from top to bottom — immediate, confident, takes about 300ms.
- The illustrated membership badge drifts in from a slight downward offset (20px) and settles into position — arrives about a beat after the background fills.
- The eyebrow pill ("Sproutly Club" in Puddle Purple) fades in first among the type elements.
- The headline "First In. Best Dressed." slides up from 30px below and snaps into place — large, bold, unhurried.
- The subheadline fades in a beat after the headline settles.
- The CTA button scales up from 90% to 100% with a slight bounce — the last element to arrive, drawing the eye naturally.
- The membership badge has a slow, continuous ambient float — a gentle 6px vertical drift on a 4-second loop — throughout the page session.

### Scroll-Triggered Reveals
- **Section 2 (Feature Grid):** The eyebrow and headline slide up together. The six benefit cards stagger in from bottom, 80ms apart, each scaling from 96% to 100% with a fade. Icons get a small pop (scale 0 → 1.1 → 1) as their card arrives.
- **Section 3 (Testimonials):** The three cards slide in from the right, staggered 120ms apart. The oversized Sunshine Squeal quote marks fade in first, then the card content follows.
- **Section 4 (FAQ):** The headline slides up. Accordion rows fade in staggered from top to bottom, 60ms apart.
- **Section 5 (Form):** The confetti burst signature motion (described above).
- **Section 6 (Exit CTA):** Simple fade-up, gentle and quiet.

### Hover & Focus Affordances
- **CTA buttons:** Lift 3px, shadow deepens, background shifts one tone (Adventure Sky CTAs darken slightly; Playdate Coral CTAs brighten). Scale 1.02. Transition is quick (~150ms).
- **Benefit cards:** Lift 4px, shadow grows, the Sprout Mint background on the icon circle brightens. The icon itself scales 1.1.
- **Testimonial cards:** Subtle lift 2px, border color shifts from transparent to Sunshine Squeal.
- **FAQ accordion rows:** Background shifts from Soft Pebble to white; the Puddle Purple left border thickens from 2px to 4px; the row label shifts to Muddy Trail at full opacity.
- **Nav links:** Underline grows from 0 to full width in Adventure Sky, left to right.
- **Secondary text CTAs (Section 6):** Underline in Sprout Mint grows left to right; text shifts from 70% to 100% Muddy Trail opacity.

### Ambient Looped Motion
- Hero badge: slow 6px vertical float on 4-second loop (described above).
- Section 5 confetti background: the tiled pattern has a very slow, almost imperceptible drift — moving 2px over 8 seconds and looping — giving the background a living, breathing quality.
- The submit button in Section 5 pulses softly every 6 seconds (scale 1.0 → 1.02 → 1.0) to maintain draw after the entrance animation settles.

### Color & Surface Logic
- Section 1 (Hero): Adventure Sky (#3AABF0) full-bleed background.
- Section 2 (Benefits): Soft Pebble (#F2F0ED) background; Sprout Mint (#4DDBB4) icon circle fills; Puddle Purple (#B57BFF) eyebrow pill.
- Section 3 (Testimonials): White (#FFFFFF) background; Sunshine Squeal (#FFD93D) quote marks; Soft Pebble card fills.
- Section 4 (FAQ): Alternating White / Soft Pebble rows; Puddle Purple active-state border.
- Section 5 (Form): Adventure Sky full-bleed with confetti pattern; white form card; Playdate Coral submit button and eyebrow.
- Section 6 (Exit): White background; Sprout Mint underline accents on CTAs.

### Typography Hierarchy
- H1 (hero headline): Nunito 900, ~64px desktop / ~40px mobile, Sproutly Cloud (#FFFFFF), tight letter-spacing.
- H2 (section titles): Nunito 700, ~36px desktop / ~28px mobile, Muddy Trail (#3D3535), sentence case.
- H3 (card/benefit titles): Nunito 600, ~20px, Muddy Trail.
- Body: DM Sans 400, 16–18px, Muddy Trail at 70% opacity for meta labels, full opacity for body copy.
- Eyebrow pills: Fredoka One, 13px, uppercase, rendered as rounded pill badges in Puddle Purple (white text) or Playdate Coral (white text).
- Quote marks (Section 3): Fredoka One or Nunito 900 used decoratively at ~80px, Sunshine Squeal, purely ornamental.
- Form labels: DM Sans 500, 14px, Muddy Trail.
- CTA button text: DM Sans 500, 16px, white.

### Responsive Behavior
- **Desktop (≥1024px):** Hero is full-bleed with badge centered or offset right; benefits grid is 3 columns; testimonials are 3 columns; FAQ is single-column centered at max 760px; form card is centered at max 560px; exit CTA is centered.
- **Tablet (768–1023px):** Benefits grid drops to 2 columns; testimonials stack to 2 columns (third card below); hero badge scales down.
- **Mobile (<768px):** Hero badge stacks above headline; benefits grid is 1 column; testimonials are 1 column; FAQ accordion is full-width; form card is full-width with 20px horizontal padding; exit CTA stacks buttons vertically.

### Design System Fit
This page uses the full Sproutly palette expressively — Adventure Sky as a dominant structural color (not just buttons), Sunshine Squeal as a decorative accent at scale, Puddle Purple for eyebrows and FAQ states, Playdate Coral for the conversion CTA, and Sprout Mint for benefit icon fills. The rounded-card language, illustrated icons, and soft color blocks are at full amplitude. The page avoids the SaaS template trap by: using Adventure Sky as a full-bleed hero background (not just a button color), making the testimonial quote marks an oversized decorative typographic element, giving the FAQ a left-border active state rather than a generic chevron-only accordion, and making the conversion form a celebration panel rather than a neutral white box.
